Tottenham defender Ben Davies will not let his feelings for his Wales teammate, Sam Vokes, affect the game against Burnley on Sunday. Tottenham is going to Turf Moor hoping to keep their good performance going. They have only lost one game in the last four Premier League matches before the international break, and that loss was to Manchester United. They want to keep their chances of qualifying for European competitions alive.

Burnley is fighting to stay in the league. They are currently in 18th place, but they are only one point away from safety. Earlier this season, Sam Vokes scored for Burnley against Tottenham in the FA Cup. At that time, Ben Davies turned away after Burnley tied the game.

Neil Redfearn, the manager of Leeds United, is thinking about his job after the club suspended his assistant, Steve Thompson, on Thursday. It took the club two months to hire Thompson, but he received a letter from the director of football, Nicola Salerno, yesterday morning. The letter said Thompson is suspended until the end of the season. This means he will leave the club after only 105 days. Thompson was told that his suspension lasts until his contract ends at the end of the season. He was also told that the club will not renew his contract.

John Carver says he will push his Newcastle players hard to get them ready for Sunday’s game against Sunderland at the Stadium of Light. Newcastle has lost the last four games to Sunderland. Carver, who was Alan Pardew’s assistant during those losses, admits that Sunderland worked harder and wanted to win more than Newcastle did. He said, “In the last four games, Sunderland out-worked us, and that’s not a good thing.” Carver says he will “whip” his players to make sure they are motivated to beat Sunderland on Sunday.

David Templeton, a player for Rangers, said that the previous coaches, Ally McCoist and Kenny McDowall, did not train the team well. He praised the new coach, Stuart McCall, for bringing better coaching and game plans. McCall has been with the team for a short time since last month, and his work has helped the team win two games in a row. This has made the players feel more confident ahead of their next home game against Hearts, who are leading the league.

Nolito, a player for Celta Vigo, says that Lionel Messi should stay home on Sunday instead of playing in their match. Messi has been training after having a small foot problem, and he is expected to be ready for the game. However, Nolito, who is 28 years old, thinks Messi should not take the risk. He told the newspaper Marca that he hopes Messi will come, but he would prefer if Messi spent the day at the beach. Nolito also joked that he would call Messi’s father soon. Messi is likely to be healthy enough to play against Celta Vigo for Barcelona after recovering from his foot injury. On Thursday, Messi was seen training with his teammate Javier Mascherano.

Robbie Neilson, the manager of Hearts, says that players like captain Danny Wilson will only leave the club if it is the right decision for Hearts. This week, Sportsmail reported that Celtic is interested in signing Wilson, who used to play for Rangers. Before Sunday’s game against Celtic, Neilson admitted that other clubs showing interest in his players is normal. He stated that he will not sell any players unless it is good for the club. He agrees with the club’s owner, Ann Budge, that players will only leave if Neilson approves and the price is right.

Sam Allardyce, the manager of West Ham, has warned Brendan Rodgers, the manager of Liverpool, that giving Raheem Sterling a very high new salary could cause problems for the rest of the team. Allardyce believes that if Sterling is paid more than the £100,000 per week he was previously offered, his teammates will also ask for higher pay.

Allardyce does not blame Sterling for trying to get the best deal possible. Sterling currently earns £35,000 per week at Liverpool. Allardyce thinks that because there are so few talented young players available, clubs are willing to pay huge amounts of money to sign any young talent they can find.

Raheem Sterling, who plays for both Liverpool and England, has not yet

Blackpool is trying to sign Thomas Piermayr, a 25-year-old defender from Austria. He has been training with the club this week, and Blackpool wants to bring him in for next season, when they expect to play in League One.

Piermayr is currently a free agent. He last played for the Colorado Rapids. Before that, he played for Inverness Caledonian Thistle in 2011. He also played for Austria’s Under-21 team.

He has never played in England, but Blackpool could be his first chance to do so.

Tony Pulis plans to talk with West Bromwich Albion chairman Jeremy Peace after the team is safe from relegation. His goal is to help the club become a top-ten team again. Pulis says the team has lost its way in recent seasons and needs major changes to get back on track. Under previous managers Roy Hodgson and Steve Clarke, West Brom finished 10th and 8th. Last season, the team struggled to stay in the league and finished 17th. The image shows manager Tony Pulis shouting instructions from the sideline during a match against Manchester City.

Arsenal legend Ian Wright is upset that Theo Walcott might leave north London. He thinks Walcott’s problems at the club are because Arsene Wenger refused to play him as a striker. Walcott has only started five games for Arsenal this season after returning from a serious knee injury that kept him out for seven months. Since Arsenal is trying to sign Raheem Sterling and Walcott’s contract ends next summer, Wright is worried that the team could lose a valuable player.

Roberto Martinez believes Ross Barkley will become a more important player for both Everton and England now that he has overcome the difficulties of his second season at Everton. Barkley’s recent season with Everton was not very good. This was partly because he was selected for England’s World Cup team last summer, and partly because a knee surgery delayed his return to playing for his club. However, England coach Roy Hodgson still trusts the 21-year-old. Martinez thinks that Barkley’s two recent appearances as a substitute for England against Lithuania and Italy show that he is ready to improve his performance.

England will not play in the Under 19 European Championships this summer. They lost 2-1 to France in their final qualifying match.

Before this game, England had won against Denmark and Azerbaijan. They needed to beat France in Saint-Lo to qualify for the finals in Greece in July.

France scored two goals, one by Sehrou Guirassy and one by Gnaly Cornet. England’s Patrick Roberts scored a late goal, but it was not enough to help England qualify.

Newcastle player Jonas Gutierrez wants to win the upcoming match against Sunderland. This game is important because it is a rivalry between the two teams. Gutierrez is 31 years old and comes from Argentina. He recently returned to playing after recovering from testicular cancer. In the last three games, he came on as a substitute, but Newcastle lost all of them. Fans have welcomed him back warmly. Now, he hopes to stop the losing streak. Newcastle has lost four games in a row, and they want to win against Sunderland on Sunday.

After a close game between South Sydney and Canterbury, angry fans threw plastic water bottles and insults at the referees and officials. The match ended in controversy because the referees penalized Canterbury’s captain, James Graham, in the last minute. This penalty helped South Sydney win 18-17. The game took place at ANZ Stadium in Sydney on Good Friday. As the referees and players left the field, a group of fans started throwing objects and shouting abuse at them.

Kevin Sinfield, the former captain of the England rugby team, has been told that he will be a target when he switches to rugby union at the end of the season. Sinfield, who is 34 years old and considered the best captain in Leeds' history, surprised the rugby league world on Tuesday by announcing that he will stop playing rugby league and join Yorkshire Carnegie, a sister club of Leeds Rhinos, on an 18-month contract.

Raheem Sterling said he is not ready to sign a new contract with Liverpool, even though the club offered him £100,000 a week to stay. The 20-year-old player is getting closer to leaving the team. In an interview with the BBC on Wednesday, he said that if he had been asked a year ago, he would have signed for much less money.

Even though Sterling is one of Liverpool’s best players, he has not played as well as he did last season. This season, he has scored only six goals. That is one fewer goal than Jon Walters, who plays for Stoke. His ability to score goals and the number of minutes he plays per goal have both gotten worse, as shown in the graphic below.

Brighton and Hove Albion, a football team in the Championship, are the first club to teach its young players about the laws and ethics of sexual consent. According to the BBC, the club’s "Protect, Inform and Prevent" (PIP) program explains how consent works in legal terms. The training includes private question-and-answer sessions where players can discuss past experiences. These sessions are led by a former police detective and a psychotherapist.

A new video shows homeless people reading cruel tweets written about them. This video was made by the agency Leo Burnett Toronto for the charity Humans For Humans. The goal is to make people think more carefully about how they treat homeless people. Many of the people in the video cry while reading comments such as, "I hate the homeless, I don’t feel sorry for you," and "I saw a homeless girl across the street. I almost vomited."

George Boyd is the hardest-working player in the Barclays Premier League. He has run 210.5 miles this season. This distance is the same as running from Burnley’s Turf Moor stadium to Crystal Palace’s Selhurst Park in south London. Boyd has run slightly farther than Tottenham Hotspur’s Christian Eriksen. Walking that distance would normally take 69 hours, according to Google Maps. However, Boyd has covered it in less than 40 hours of playing time.

Police have arrested the parents of a five-month-old baby who was found dead. The father, 25, and the mother, 25, live in Perry Barr, Birmingham. They were taken into custody after their daughter died yesterday afternoon.

Police were called to the family’s home just before 1 a.m. yesterday because the baby was having trouble breathing. The child was taken to Birmingham Children’s Hospital, but she died a few hours later.

A police spokesperson said the death is being treated as suspicious. A post-mortem examination will take place today to find out exactly what caused the baby’s death.

Gordon Taylor, the head of the players' union, says Raheem Sterling is not being disloyal to Liverpool by pausing contract talks until the summer. The 20-year-old English player has received a huge offer from manager Brendan Rodgers, which is believed to be £100,000 per week. However, the negotiations have reached a deadlock. Sterling says he is not just trying to get more money, and Taylor thinks it is smart to wait until the season ends before continuing the discussions. Sterling also admitted in a TV interview that he is not ready to sign a new contract with Liverpool yet.

Things have been difficult for Anderson, a former Manchester United player who returned to Brazil, but on Wednesday, his mistakes were overshadowed by a teammate’s foolish behavior. Anderson was sent off from the game at Internacional after shoving an opponent, Otacilio Neto, during the first half. This incident also resulted in Neto being sent off for hitting back with an elbow. However, Anderson’s teammate, Fabricio, drew more attention by swearing at his own fans. Fabricio became the third player to receive a red card, leaving Internacional with only nine players. The match ended in a 1-1 tie in Porto Alegre.

A seven-year-old boy was attacked by two young men while he was buying food. The attackers took him to a remote location and raped him. When the boy tried to fight back, they set him on fire.

According to Inspector Sasthe, the boy suffered burns covering 30 percent of his body but managed to escape. The incident happened in Padma Nagar, a neighborhood in Bhiwandi, which is a suburb of Mumbai. Police are currently investigating the case.

A pug named Dug has fully recovered after being bitten in the face by a rattlesnake. Dug and his owner, Lindsay Castro, were hiking on the Jurupa Hills trail in Fontana, California, on Thursday. They heard a rattling sound, which came from a snake. Lindsay moved back, but Dug ran toward the snake. The snake bit Dug in the face, and his face swelled to twice its normal size.

Real Madrid defender Alvaro Arbeloa says that Jose Mourinho might come back to manage the team in the future. Mourinho left Real Madrid in 2013 to go back to Chelsea. His departure was difficult, and there were rumors that he had arguments with key players like Iker Casillas, Sergio Ramos, and Pepe. However, Arbeloa believes that Real Madrid will always be open to hiring Mourinho again as their coach.

On Saturday, Liverpool and manager Brendan Rodgers reached the end of their efforts at the Emirates Stadium. Their hopes of qualifying for the Champions League are now gone. During a 15-minute press conference, Rodgers admitted that his team’s chances of making it to the Champions League were over. This marked the end of missed opportunities.

Rodgers tried to stay positive. He does not usually show sadness, but he did not pretend that this has been an easy season. Last year, Liverpool fought hard for the title, but this year they have fallen out of the race. It is a hard reality for a club that thought it was returning to success. Even so, it still feels like Liverpool are moving forward under Rodgers.

Inter Milan coach Roberto Mancini was angry after his team tied 1-1 with Parma, a team at the bottom of the league. Because of this result, Inter Milan is now tied for ninth place and is 10 points away from the spots that qualify for European competitions.

To punish the players for their poor attitude, Mancini cancelled their Easter day off. He ordered them to come in for an early morning training session on Sunday. The team trained at 8:30 a.m. local time. Club vice-president Javier Zanetti and sporting director Piero Ausilio watched the session. Inter Milan confirmed this on their website, www.inter.it.

Many fans want to buy rare items from their favorite players or teams, and small pieces of history can sell for thousands of pounds. However, you might be surprised to learn that an expired passport belonging to Paul Parker was listed on eBay for £5,000. Paul Parker is well-known for playing as a right-back for Manchester United and England in the 1990s. The passport was listed in early March, and the bidding ended on Tuesday. It is not clear if anyone actually paid the high price.

People have seen images of Jesus on toast, pancakes, chips, and even ice cream. But a builder was surprised when he found an image of Jesus on a piece of wood just a few days before Easter.

Paddy Morrall, a 31-year-old builder from Keighley near Bradford, saw the image on a broken scaffolding board in Inverness, Scotland, on Wednesday. The image showed Jesus wearing a robe. It appeared after Paddy and his coworkers left the wood outside in the rain for several hours. Paddy has kept the board.

On Tuesday, Slovakia beat the Czech Republic 1-0 in a friendly match. Ondrej Duda, a 20-year-old player, scored the winning goal just after halftime. He kicked the ball from outside the penalty area in the 49th minute. This was his second goal for his country.

Since Czechoslovakia split into two separate countries in 1993, Slovakia has won three of the ten matches against the Czech Republic. The Czech Republic has won five games.

During the match, Slovakia’s Martin Skrtel hit Czech player Daniel Kolar in the face with his foot. Slovakia celebrated their win, which continues their good recent performance.

Karim Benzema, a star player for Real Madrid, showed that he has talents beyond football. He posted a video of himself rapping while driving his Bugatti Veyron. The video was shared just before Real Madrid plays Granada at the Bernabeu stadium on Sunday. In the video, Benzema sings along to a classic song by Tupac called "Check Out Time." Although "All Eyez on Me" might have been a better song choice for him, Benzema is currently focused on scoring. He has already scored 20 goals in all competitions this season.

Harvey Boulter, a businessman who supports UKIP, is trying to stop a Conservative candidate from winning. He previously helped force Liam Fox to quit his job as Defence Secretary. Now, he is spending money to defeat another Conservative candidate, Tom Tugendhat, in the Tonbridge and West Malling area of Kent.

Boulter has already given £30,000 to a UKIP candidate who is running against Fox in Somerset. He is also spending another £30,000 to try to defeat Tugendhat.

Sheffield Wednesday and Huddersfield tied 1-1 in their match. Two goals were scored in the final four minutes of the game. Sergiu Bus, who came on as a substitute for Sheffield Wednesday, scored the first goal in the 86th minute. Ishmael Miller, also a substitute for Huddersfield, scored an equalizing goal just before the end of the match. This result means Huddersfield has not won any of their last seven games. They are currently 18th in the league standings, six places and nine points behind Sheffield Wednesday. Sergiu Bus is shown celebrating after putting Sheffield Wednesday ahead.

Stuart Dallas has made huge progress since Mark Warburton noticed him playing part-time for a local team called Crusaders, where he earned just £70 a week. Now 23 years old, Dallas played well for Northern Ireland recently and scored two great goals when Brentford beat Fulham 4-1 on Good Friday. Because of this success, Brentford is aiming for more than just a spot in the playoffs. This is a big change from three years ago, when Warburton saw Dallas playing on a muddy field back home. Dallas has been a surprise success this season, helping Brentford move closer to reaching the Premier League.

Baseball is America’s most popular hobby, so it makes sense that people feel strongly about their favorite professional team. The New York Yankees and Boston Red Sox are the biggest rivals and the most famous teams. They are also the most popular, with the Yankees ranking first and the Red Sox second in the number of fans who support them. The Texas Rangers and Atlanta Braves also have many fans, especially in the South. Some teams, like the New York Mets, have fewer fans. Scroll down for the video.

Trey Moses, a basketball player at Eastern High School in Louisville, Kentucky, made a girl named Ellie Meredith happy by asking her to be his date for prom. Ellie has Down syndrome. Trey is a senior and will play basketball for Ball State University next year. He also volunteers with teenagers who have learning disabilities.

During Ellie’s physical education class, Trey surprised her with flowers and a sign that said, “Let’s Party Like it’s 1989.” This is a reference to a song by Taylor Swift, who is Ellie’s favorite singer. Ellie said yes and told CNN that she is excited to go dress shopping because she has already told many people about the event.

On April Fools' Day, President Barack Obama pretended to be Frank Underwood, a character from the TV show *House of Cards*. Frank Underwood is played by actor Kevin Spacey, who won an Oscar. In the show, Frank often talks directly to the audience in a style similar to Shakespeare.

Obama said, "Hello everybody. This is not Frank Underwood. This is Barack Obama. Happy April Fools' Day. Frank learned it from me." He also used a Southern accent to sound like the character.

Ludovic Obraniak, a midfielder for Caykur Rizespor, was taken to the hospital on Saturday because of a possible heart problem. He was playing in a match against Fenerbahce when he had to leave the game after only 30 minutes. After he left, doctors performed tests. The team said on social media that he is not in immediate danger. Obraniak is currently playing for Caykur Rizespor on loan from Werder Bremen, a German team. Fenerbahce won the match 5-1, and their player Moussa Sow scored a goal.

Three people were taken to the hospital after a crash on Easter Sunday night. The accident happened at a traffic light on Warringah Road in Frenchs Forest, northern Sydney. A 1973 E-Type Jaguar, which is worth more than $120,000, crashed head-on with a Toyota Kluger. The Jaguar was completely destroyed. No one was injured, but all three adults went to the hospital as a precaution. NSW police are still investigating how the crash happened.

People in Shandong Province, in eastern China, are carrying natural gas in plastic bags. Recent photos show residents from Lijin village in Dongying city using rickshaws to transport gas in bags that can be up to six meters long. The People’s Daily Online reported this.

People who saw this were worried. They compared it to carrying a bomb because a spark, a flame, or even a cigarette could cause a disaster.

This is a common sight in some villages in Shandong. Local media say this is a way for villages to save money on transporting gas.

Tiger Woods was seen practicing at Augusta National, which makes people hopeful that he will play in this year’s first major golf tournament. He has not played on the PGA Tour since February 5, when he quit the Farmers Insurance Open because his back pain came back. He has taken time off to try to get back to his best form, but many people think he will return for the Masters, a tournament he has won four times. Woods was seen practicing at Augusta on Tuesday, and reports say he has gone back to the course. He has fallen out of the top 100 in the world rankings for the first time in nearly 19 years.

The BBC is being criticized for spending thousands of pounds of public money on a 44-page guide that teaches staff how to use emojis correctly. BBC executives hired an agency to research how smiley faces could be used in news stories and on social media. They also asked designers to create graphics of emojis for popular stars like Gary Lineker and Graham Norton. This spending happened before the BBC used a "sad face" emoji to report the death of the world's oldest woman.

Moses Kipsiro, a top long-distance runner and frequent training partner of Mo Farah, says he is afraid for his life. This fear started after he reported to authorities in Uganda that a coach was sexually abusing female runners, some of whom were as young as 15. Kipsiro, who won the 10,000-meter title at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow last year, told Sportsmail that five female runners came to him for help. After he reported the abuse to the national sports federation and the police, he received death threats.

Patrick Kluivert, a former player and assistant coach for the Netherlands, has started well as the coach of Curacao. His team advanced to the next round of World Cup qualifying for 2018 on Tuesday night.

Curacao tied 2-2 in the second game against Montserrat, which gave them a total score of 4-3. They had already won 2-1 in Willemstad on Saturday.

Kluivert helped Curacao move to the next stage of the 2018 World Cup qualification. He previously worked with Louis van Gaal at the 2014 World Cup.

An 18-year-old student named Brady Eaves was expelled from his fraternity, removed from college, and sent for a mental health evaluation after a video showed him biting the head off a live hamster. The Daily Mail reported last weekend that Eaves, who was privately educated and the stepson of a former candidate for governor in Mississippi, laughed while killing the small animal during a drunken Spring Break party in Florida. The video could lead to felony animal cruelty charges against him, which carry a maximum penalty of five years in jail and a $5,000 fine.

Sri Lanka’s sports minister, Navin Dissanayake, asked Kumar Sangakkara to stay in limited-overs cricket for one more year. Sangakkara had announced his retirement from one-day cricket on March 18. He was upset because Sri Lanka lost in the World Cup quarter-finals. He also said he was happy that the team was in a better position now than when he started playing in 2000. Dissanayake made this request after naming a new temporary group to manage the sport, led by former test cricketer Sidath Wettimuny.

Edinburgh is bringing back three Scottish players for their match against London Irish on Sunday. This game is part of the European Challenge Cup quarter-finals.

The players are Dougie Fife, Alasdair Dickinson, and Ross Ford. They did not play in last week’s Pro12 game, where Edinburgh beat the Scarlets 26-15. They were rested because they had just played for Scotland in the Six Nations tournament.

Head coach Alan Solomons has called them back for the upcoming game at Madejski Stadium. He wants to pick his strongest team. Dougie Fife is one of three Scottish players returning to Edinburgh after playing for their country in the Six Nations.

Chris Ramsey says Tony Pulis is one of the best coaches in Britain, but Ramsey’s team does not need to copy Pulis’s tactics. Ramsey’s team, QPR, plays against Pulis’s team, West Brom, on Saturday. QPR is currently 19th in the league, four points behind Sunderland, who are 17th. QPR has earned only four points since the start of the year. They need a strong finish like Pulis had with Crystal Palace in 2013-14. In that season, Crystal Palace earned 17 points in their last eight games to avoid being relegated. Chris Ramsey praised Tony Pulis before this important match.

An 18-year-old girl named Silhan Ozcelik appeared in court. She is accused of planning to travel abroad to join Kurdish rebels who are fighting against the Islamic State.

Silhan, who is a sixth-form student, went missing from her Kurdish family’s home in north London last October. At that time, she was only 17 years old.

The court heard that she traveled on the Eurostar train with another man to Stuttgart, Germany. This is where the youth group of the Kurdish Workers’ Party (PKK) has its headquarters.

Silhan is accused of preparing to carry out a terrorist attack in October 2014.

Esteban Cambiasso, a midfielder for Leicester City, has won many major football awards before.
